synth:control:erdos_769.variants.growth_.rationale: The yes/no question whether cutoff c has a finite limit of log c(n)/(n log n) is encoded directly as existence of that real limit.

synth:wrong-answer-marker:erdos_1105.par.rationale: The AR(n,P_k) formula is formalized correctly, but answer(False) asserts it fails despite the informal pointing to Yuan’s announced proof that it holds.

synth:control:exists_quasiperfect.rationale: The conjecture that quasiperfect numbers exist is exactly the existential ∃ n, Quasiperfect n.

synth:control:promislow_group_is_torsion.rationale: IsMulTorsionFree PromislowGroup is the direct formalization of the Promislow group being torsion-free.

synth:control:dense_iff_limit_point_set.rationale: Density of the (closed) limit-point set in [0,∞) is equated with equality to Ici 0, matching Weisenberg’s remark.

synth:control:erdos_889.variants.V1_eq_1.rationale: Finiteness of {n | V_1(n)=1} is exactly the question whether V_1(n)=1 has finitely many solutions.

synth:control:erdos_770.parts.ii.rationale: liminf h = ∞ is formalized as liminf h atTop = ⊤.

synth:control:tournament_anti_sidorenko_.rationale: Every finite tree has an orientation whose homomorphism density is at most 2^{-e(T)} against every tournamenton, matching the conjecture.

synth:control:erdos_1128.prikryMills.rationale: A 2-colouring of an ℵ₁-sized cube with no countable monochromatic box is exactly the Prikry–Mills lemma.

synth:missing-hypothesis:beaver_math_oly.rationale: The odd/even cumulative counter b is given only b 0 = 0 with no recurrence tying it to a, so the claim is unconstrained and stronger than the Antihydra conjecture.

synth:extraneous-hypothesis:hasMaximally.rationale: Injectivity of completion (and 0 < n) is assumed though the informal completion criterion only requires the coefficient to have the correct squared norm.

synth:control:erdos_386.rationale: A fixed k≥2 for which infinitely many n have C(n,k) a product of consecutive primes matches the informal question.
